dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 タム dams reservoirs and flood defences series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(ダム [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 全国のダムについて、形式（アーチダム、重力式コンクリートダム、ロックフィルダム等）、目的（洪水調節・農地防災、灌漑用水、発電等）、総貯水量、有効貯水量、事業者、名称等の位置を整備したデータ。 作成年度：平成26年度 原典資料：国土地理院「基盤地図情報及び電子地形図（タイル）」（財）日本ダム協会「ダム年鑑2015」. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are 国交DPF. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
